title: VITA-GBM: EPIC-0502-driven HIF1alpha degradation overcomes bevacizumab resistance and synergizes with TMZ in glioblastoma.
authors: Ding, Yaqing; Zhan, Qi; Cui, Longtao; Cui, Xiaoteng; Zhao, Yilin; Wang, Qixue; Hong, Biao; Huang, Yanping; Su, Dongyuan; Cheng, Chunchao; Xu, Hanyi; Liang, Siwen; Zhao, Xun; Liu, Yuhao; Kang, Chunsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子EPIC-0502通过降解HIF1alpha增强胶质母细胞瘤对TMZ/BEV的敏感性，虽用分子动力学模拟，但核心是代谢与肿瘤治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Glioblastoma (GBM) is characterized by extensive tissue hypoxia. This hypoxic microenvironment drives chemoresistance and promotes aberrant vascularization, critically limiting the efficacy of temozolomide (TMZ) and bevacizumab (BEV). Here, we report EPIC-0502, a novel small-molecule competitive antagonist that inhibits hypoxia signaling while sensitizing GBM to both TMZ and BEV. METHODS: EPIC-0502 was identified through molecular dynamics simulation. Its target blocking effect was validated via non-targeted metabolomics, stable isotope tracing-based metabolic flux analysis, and pull-down assays. The mechanisms underlying EPIC-0502 activity were elucidated by Western Blot (WB), Co-Immunoprecipitation (Co-IP), ELISA, Seahorse assays, and Immunofluorescence (IF). The sensitizing effects of EPIC-0502 on TMZ and BEV were evaluated in orthotopic GBM models. RESULTS: EPIC-0502 inhibited alpha-ketoglutarate (alpha-KG) to succinate conversion, depleting cytoplasmic succinate levels and inhibiting phosphoglycerate kinase 1 (PGK1) succinylation and phosphorylation, which significantly attenuated glycolysis. Furthermore, EPIC-0502 destabilized Hypoxia-inducible factor 1 alpha (HIF1alpha) by promoting hydroxylation-dependent ubiquitination, while impairing its transcriptional activity. Through HIF1alpha degradation, EPIC-0502 enhanced GBM sensitivity to TMZ via E2F1 downregulation and reversed hypoxia-induced vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGFA) overexpression, potentiating the antiangiogenic efficacy of BEV. Collectively, these actions enable EPIC-0502 to synergistically enhance the therapeutic efficacy of TMZ/BEV combination. CONCLUSIONS: Based on EPIC-0502-driven HIF1alpha degradation that overcomes BEV resistance and synergizes with TMZ, we propose the novel VITA-GBM regimen comprising: Vascular targeting (BEV), Inhibition of hypoxia signaling (EPIC-0502), TMZ chemotherapy, and Alignment of synergistic mechanisms. This strategy enhances the efficacy of first-line therapies and provides a promising approach to improve overall survival in GBM patients.
abstract_zh: 背景：胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）以广泛的组织缺氧为特征。这种缺氧微环境驱动化疗耐药并促进异常血管生成，严重限制了替莫唑胺（TMZ）和贝伐珠单抗（BEV）的疗效。在此，我们报道EPIC-0502，一种新型小分子竞争性拮抗剂，可抑制缺氧信号同时使GBM对TMZ和BEV增敏。方法：通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟鉴定EPIC-0502。其靶点阻断效应通过非靶向代谢组学、基于稳定同位素示踪的代谢流分析及pull-down实验验证。EPIC-0502活性的机制通过Western Blot（WB）、免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）、ELISA、Seahorse实验和免疫荧光（IF）阐明。EPIC-0502对TMZ和BEV的增敏作用在原位GBM模型中评估。结果：EPIC-0502抑制α-酮戊二酸（alpha-KG）向琥珀酸的转化，耗竭胞质琥珀酸水平并抑制磷酸甘油酸激酶1（PGK1）的琥珀酰化和磷酸化，从而显著减弱糖酵解。此外，EPIC-0502通过促进羟化依赖性泛素化使缺氧诱导因子1α（HIF1alpha）失稳，同时损害其转录活性。通过HIF1alpha降解，EPIC-0502经E2F1下调增强GBM对TMZ的敏感性，并逆转缺氧诱导的血管内皮生长因子A（VEGFA）过表达，增强BEV的抗血管生成疗效。综合这些作用，EPIC-0502能够协同增强TMZ/BEV联合治疗的效果。结论：基于EPIC-0502驱动的HIF1alpha降解克服BEV耐药并与TMZ协同，我们提出新型VITA-GBM方案，包括：血管靶向（BEV）、缺氧信号抑制（EPIC-0502）、TMZ化疗及协同机制整合。该策略增强一线治疗疗效，为改善GBM患者总生存期提供了一种有前景的方法。
